title: Light Computer Components (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Lasers, waveguides, modulators, detectors: the photonic piece set, all real technology. The Signature extension standardizes the photonic cell: one tile containing source, guide, modulator, and detector in a fixed layout, mass-producible like a memory chip. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
capabilities: Generate coherent light at precise wavelengths
Guide light through waveguides without loss
Modulate amplitude, phase, and frequency at speed
Detect photons and convert them to signals
Integrate all pieces on photonic chips

The Signature extension prints waveguides in three dimensions: stacked photonic layers with vertical couplers, multiplying routing density the way 3D chips did.
